Package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.resourceserver

Class ResourceServerClientConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.bff.infrastructure.resourceserver.ResourceServerClientConfiguration
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false) @EnableConfigurationProperties(ResourceServerProperties.class) public class ResourceServerClientConfiguration extends Object
Builds the client of the resource server: the RestClient that carries the access token of the signed-in user, and the DocumentsApi generated from the resource server's contract on top of it. The OAuth2AuthorizedClientManager is the one the web adapter's security configuration declares; this module only depends on its type.

  • Method Details

    • resourceServerRestClient

      @Bean org.springframework.web.client.RestClient resourceServerRestClient(org.springframework.web.client.RestClient.Builder builder, org.springframework.security.oauth2.client.OAuth2AuthorizedClientManager manager)
      Builds the REST client of the resource server. Its interceptor asks the authorized client manager for the access token of the user of the current request (renewing it with the refresh token when it expired) and sets it as the bearer token of the outgoing request; a call whose session has no token is never sent. When the token cannot be obtained or renewed it throws an OAuth2AuthorizationException, which RestDocumentGateway reports as DocumentsUnauthorizedException, answered 401 so the SPA signs in again.
      Parameters:
      builder - the builder of REST clients, the one test slices bind a mock server to.
      manager - the manager of the authorized clients of the session.
      Returns:
      the REST client of the resource server.
